turns.assessment: The direct critical EQPT_CARD_FAIL alarm on the S15 endpoint of lightpath och40 is decisive. A card failure there explains both the loss of the channel transmitted toward S08 (including the downstream OCM losses and OCH_LOS at S08) and the loss/silencing of the local receiver monitoring at S15. Unchanged amplifier telemetry and unaffected neighboring channels argue against a span, amplifier, or ROADM common-path fault.

proposals.rationale: O1 explicitly reports equipment card failure at this unit. Its documented bidirectional signature matches the observations: its transmitted och40 signal disappears at S08, while its own receiver and monitoring become invalid. This loss caused svc024 to switch from working to protection.
